headline: Eagle Materials (EXP) Tops Q1 Earnings and Revenue Estimates
summary: Eagle Materials (EXP) delivered earnings and revenue surprises of +0.92% and +3.56%, respectively, for the quarter ended June 2026. Do the numbers hold clues to what lies ahead for the stock?
